Thumbnail admin

Manage article cover images and persist them to this local server. This tool edits a static JSON catalog — it does not upload images anywhere.

Select an article to see its current cover image.
No preview
Paste an image URL (Unsplash works well). Leave blank to remove the cover for the selected article.

This shows the catalog that will be saved. Use Save to server to persist it to this local preview server. The next rebuild (node build.js) bakes those covers into the article pages.

How to use
  • Pick an article from the dropdown.
  • Paste its cover image URL.
  • Click Save to server. The catalog at /admin/thumbnails.json is updated immediately.
  • Run node build.js to bake the new covers into the article pages.
  • Existing coverImage values already in an article file take priority over the catalog.
